behavior.tempfile_or_non_live: Always applies full SCHEMA via executescript. Env is ignored.
behavior.live_without_env_incomplete: RO probe; raises live_schema_incomplete. Does not RW-open.
behavior.live_without_env_complete: RW open, pragmas only, no SCHEMA executescript, no additive DDL.
behavior.live_with_env_1: RW open then transactional additive DDL for memory_read_receipts, decision_evidence, wan_fetches plus schema_migration_version=phase3-skin-1. CREATE IF NOT EXISTS only. No DROP/rename.

note: IF NOT EXISTS makes repeat applies idempotent, but the env still authorizes live DDL on every connect. Do not persist in systemd. Validate startup with the variable unset.
